authoring.review: Every food/alias is unresolved/proposed. No independent semantic review, adoption or model-confidence claim is made.

matchKeyPolicy.punctuation: retain; variants require explicit alias entries
matchKeyPolicy.unknownOrCollidingMatch: remain unmapped; do not guess from model confidence

aliases.preparationRationale: Proposed individually: dicing describes kitchen preparation of the generic fresh bulb onion, not a new food. Does not include frozen, dried, pickled, pre-seasoned or a named precut product.
Proposed individually: slicing describes kitchen preparation of the generic fresh bulb onion. This does not license stripping other preparation/product words.
Proposed individually: émincé describes cutting the generic fresh bulb onion. It does not identify green onion, shallot, dried/pickled onion or a household-specific product.

excludedOrAmbiguous.rationale: Regional meaning can denote shallot or green onion; no bare-term exact identity proposed.

Bare pepper/piment remain ambiguous across spice/vegetable or regional heat/product meaning. Poivron is deliberately outside this seed because no bell/sweet-pepper vegetable concept is proposed; its omission does not suggest a spice meaning. Explicit ground black pepper is separately proposed.
Coriander family deliberately omitted from this bounded draft; leaf/seed and language-specific usage require separate review.
Regional fat percentages, fermentation and product uses are not interchangeable; cream family omitted.
Can mean starch or milled maize depending on region; only explicit cornstarch/amidon de maïs is proposed.
Species, fat content and processing unspecified; no milk concept included.
Salt status unresolved; salted and unsalted butter have separate proposed IDs.
Not aliases of generic fresh bulb onion; powder/other alliums require separate concepts.
Do not collapse distinct cuts/concentration into generic canned tomatoes or explicitly double-concentrated paste.
Generic grain/processing/variety missing; do not choose a specific dry grain/bean/flour identity.
Alternatives are not exact aliases of either constituent.
Firm silken versus non-silken texture is not inferred. Generic firm, extra-firm and silken wording is outside the explicitly non-silken firm concept.
Quantity/package wording is not a food alias; units, capacity, count kind and net/drained facts remain separate.

boundaries: No per-recipe mappings are authored; no Mappings array is fabricated.
FoodIds are purchase concepts, not grocery rowIds, unit definitions, package capacities or count kinds.
Labels do not automatically become aliases; only the finite explicit alias arrays are candidates.
No household-specific names, protected private corrections or DV markers enter global aliases.
No runtime/live DataRoot installation or adoption occurs. Exact proposed bytes need C/Root review and later pinning.
Full backup/staged restore must later preserve reviewed persisted bytes and references, never regenerate this candidate.
